FLOW CHART FOR LITHIUM BATTERY MEANS OF COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATION PROCESS.\n\nFlow Chart for Lithium battery Means of Compliance certification process\n\nSource image on page 40; no OCR transcription available.\n\nNotes:\n\n1. FLOW CHART FOR LITHIUM BATTERY MEANS OF COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATION PROCESS.\n\nFlow Chart for Lithium battery Means of Compliance certification process\n\nSource image on page 40; no OCR transcription available.\n\nNotes:\n\n1. Has the Top Level Unit been FAA conformed (see FAA Form 8120-10 and Order 8110-4 Appendix 4), and successfully tested per appropriate standards such as DO-311, DO-347, DO-160, DO-178 and DO-254 (or equivalent)? Has any regulatory compliance been accomplished for the Top Level Unit?\n\nII. Has the battery successfully completed any TSO MPS testing? Does it have an FAA TSO, such as TSO-C179a?\n\nIII. Has the battery been FAA conformed and successfully tested per appropriate standards such as DO-311, DO-347, DO-160, DO-178 and DO-254? Has any regulatory compliance been accomplished on the battery?\n\nIV. Is there a Functional Hazard Assessment, System Safety Assessment and or failure Modes and Effects Analysis accomplished? If so, is the Hazard Assessment catastrophic?\n\nV. The battery size is defined by Table 1-1 on page 3 of the RTCA document DO-347. See page 33 Section 2.8 of RTCA document DO-347 for industry standards.\n\nVI. The equipment must be evaluated for installation requirements. If the equipment has a TSO, the tests under the TSO MOPS can be used for compliance to the airworthiness regulations (Test Report must be provided). When there is a delta between the test accomplished under the TSO and the installation requirement based on criticality and location on aircraft only the delta tests, if any, need to be tested in order to comply with the airworthiness regulations.","end_at":1402,"id":"d7f7c708-0328-49f1-9042-f15acfd79288","image_info":"","knowledge_base_id":"17a4fb08-2f1e-4107-b1e6-c203657a3e08","knowledge_channel":"api","knowledge_filename":"AC_20-184.pdf","knowledge_id":"a55aa2ce-d249-4213-a67d-5b8ae36edfb1","knowledge_source":"internal-rag","knowledge_title":"AC_20-184.pdf","match_type":0,"matched_content":"AC_20-184.pdf\nAPPENDIX G. 试验报告、DO-311/DO-347/DO-160/DO-178/DO-254 证据为核心，保持构型可追溯。\n- **安装矩阵层**：行是要求/试验项目，列是“机型 + 安装位置 + 功能/关键性”，单元格标注“复用 / 差异试验 / 新分析 / 不适用”，并链接证据编号和修订版。\n- **安全分析层**：产品级 FHA/SSA 可共用；安装级 FHA/SSA/FMEA 必须按机型和位置分别编制，危害分类不得跨机型继承。\n- **文件层**：每个 TC/STC 或改装项目建立安装符合性档案，引用通用 TSO 档案；ICA 按机型/位置编制有效性和差异页。\n- **变更控制**：电池设计、BMS 软件、安装位置、关键性、接口、适用规章任一变化，都触发矩阵更新和差异影响分析；只有受控的“无差异”结论才能支持免试。\n\n### 4.
